mapper.select: SELECT b.bb_idx, b.bb_title, o.or_name, b.bb_reg_date, b.bb_hit, b.bb_open FROM sianadb.market.bbs b LEFT JOIN sianadb.market.org o ON b.bb_or_idx = o.or_idx WHERE o.or_name IS NOT NULL
SELECT O.OR_IDX, O.OR_ID, O.OR_NAME, O.OR_LEVEL, O.OR_CONTEST_STATUS, O.OR_RND_STATUS, O.OR_RND_STATUS, O.OR_IP_INTRO, O.OR_SEQ, O.OR_GB, O.OR_SEARCH_GROUP FROM SIANADB.MARKET.ORG O ORDER BY OR_SEQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SIANADB.MARKET.BBS( BB_BBSID, BB_OR_IDX, BB_TYPE, BB_TITLE, BB_CONTENT, BB_SEQ, BB_HIT, BB_NOTICE, BB_OPEN, BB_CONFIRM, BB_STATUS, BB_OPEN_TYPE, BB_CO_IDX, BB_REG_DATE, BB_REG_ID, BB_REG_IP ) VALUES ( #{bbBbsid}, #{bbOrIdx}, #{bbType}, #{bbTitle}, #{bbContent}, #{bbSeq}, #{bbHit}, #{bbNotice}, #{bbOpen}, #{bbConfirm}, #{bbStatus}, #{bbOpenType}, #{bbCoIdx}, now(), #{bbRegId}, #{bbRegIp} )
